context: Tests whether the agent, acting as the manager skill for '/manager --plan', produces an execution plan artifact that follows the skill's documented structure: task analysis, phased breakdown in the documented phase order (specification with specify+mentor, task breakdown with taskify, parallel go-implementor tracks, review with go-review+mentor, documentation with document), explicit phase gates and track dependencies, and success criteria — all grounded in the provided design brief.

checklist.name: Plan artifact created
checklist.description: execution-plan.md exists at the repository root and is non-trivial (not empty, not a stub).

checklist.name: Task analysis present
checklist.description: The plan opens with a task analysis covering the goal, scope (what is included/excluded from the design brief), and constraints (Postgres-only, env-flag rollout).

checklist.name: Complexity assessment present
checklist.description: The plan assesses complexity: estimated effort, technical complexity, and risk areas or dependencies that need to exist first.

checklist.name: Phases follow documented order
checklist.description: The plan is organised into phases matching the skill's template order: specification/planning, then task breakdown, then implementation, then review, then documentation — in that order, not reordered or merged away.

checklist.name: Phase 1 assigns specify and mentor
checklist.description: The specification phase assigns specify (turn the design brief into detailed specs) and mentor (architectural review) in parallel, per the template.

checklist.name: Explicit phase gate before implementation
checklist.description: The plan states implementation does not begin until the specification phase completes (a wait/gate line or equivalent), per the template's 'Wait for Phase 1 completion before proceeding'.

checklist.name: Phase 2 assigns taskify
checklist.description: The task-breakdown phase assigns taskify to convert the specs into structured tasks.

checklist.name: Phase 3 has parallel implementation tracks
checklist.description: The implementation phase defines multiple parallel go-implementor tracks covering the design brief's components, including a test track that is not serialised behind everything else.

checklist.name: Track dependencies match the design
checklist.description: Track dependencies are stated and consistent with the design brief's real chain: middleware depends on the key service/rate limiter, admin handlers depend on the middleware being in place, integration tests depend on store/service.

checklist.name: Phase 4 review assignments
checklist.description: The review phase assigns go-review for code quality and mentor for architectural correctness.

checklist.name: Phase 5 documentation assignment
checklist.description: The documentation phase assigns document for the API reference and runbook.

checklist.name: Success criteria present
checklist.description: The plan ends with a success criteria checklist covering implementation/testing, review, and documentation completion.

checklist.name: No skill misassignment
checklist.description: Work is matched per the decision framework: no phase asks go-implementor to do the code review or the architecture review, and no phase asks go-review or mentor to implement features.
